<!--
Title conventions (use lowercase prefixes):
  feat: new functionality
  fix:  bug fix
  ci:   CI / GitHub Actions changes
  docs: README / AGENTS / wiki / inline docs
  chore: tooling, deps, refactor, cleanup

Examples:
  feat: surface dev_skip_percent in /health
  ci: publish container image to GHCR on release
  docs: document OfflineService in AGENTS.md
-->

## What

One sentence: the change being requested.

## Why

The motivation — what breaks or stays painful if we don't do this. Link a parent issue / milestone / external context if relevant.

## Acceptance criteria

Concrete, verifiable bullets. An agent or reviewer should be able to tick each off mechanically.

- [ ] …
- [ ] …
- [ ] …

## Scope (optional)

If the issue could grow, name what's **in** and **out**. Helps avoid PR creep.

**In:**
- …

**Out (separate ticket if needed):**
- …

## Notes / links (optional)

- Related PRs: #
- Related issues: #
- Design doc / wiki page:
- Slack / TG thread:
